verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's webhooks documentation includes an endpoint to 'Get all webhooks in an account.' That points to a first-party webhook resource that developers can manage via API, but it is the only webhook-related item in the pack. missing for 10: documented subscription to specific delivery/engagement topics (sends, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes), a documented payload schema, payload signing/verification, a create/subscribe endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe webhooks to delivery and engagement events — sends, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes — with a documented, signed payload

citations.quote: Get all webhooks in an account.
